supportConstrainedInference.supportDensityNote: Inference is conditioned on 87 unique country-years with uneven regime occupancy; evidence is support-bounded rather than population-general.
supportConstrainedInference.highDimensionalTermsGuardrail: Higher-dimensional interaction/curvature terms are interpreted as support-constrained diagnostics and are excluded from headline claims unless independently stabilized.

interpretationBoundary.note: Tier C remains exploratory unless independent stability and OOS performance are adequate, and interpretation remains support-constrained even for Tier A/B.
guardrails: Tier A/B provide the primary inferential pathway under refit OOS protocols.
Tier C is exploratory and should not be used for headline inferential claims.
All claims are bounded by thin effective support and uneven regime coverage.
All reported effects remain descriptive/model-implied and do not establish causal effects.
